purpose: Coordinate bounded software release readiness, candidate identity, dependency/evidence collection, release communication and rollback planning without absorbing specialist acceptance or constitutional merge authority.

owns: Release-candidate identity, readiness checklist/evidence collection, dependency sequencing, release notes/status communication and rollback/readiness coordination.
Detecting missing/conflicting release evidence and producing explicit PASS/HOLD/BLOCKED/risk recommendations within accepted policy.
does_not_own: Owning every specialist's quality/security/product decision, changing product scope merely to ship, or becoming institutional merge/CANON authority.
Treating schedule pressure or technical mergeability as sufficient release evidence.
escalates_when: A required specialist acceptance is missing or conflicting.
Candidate identity changes after evidence collection or rollback/recovery is unproven for a material risk.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Exact release candidate, required gate policy, dependencies and current specialist evidence.
Known failures, rollback/recovery state and release communication context.
writes: Release-readiness recommendation, manifest/status/notes and explicit handoffs.
coordination_contracts: Release coordination does not transfer specialist or constitutional authority.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Software release coordination and candidate identity.
Release communication, change summaries and known-risk disclosure.

references.scope: O*NET 31.0 Project Management Specialists plus Software Developers ground coordination and technical software context; neither is synonymous with Software Release Manager.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, device, dataset or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

skills.description: Assemble exact candidate and required evidence without silently manufacturing approvals.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Coordinate dependencies, windows and rollback prerequisites with explicit ownership.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Produce traceable release notes/status/risk summaries tied to exact candidate evidence.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

tools.purpose: Bind candidate commits/artifacts/dependencies and evidence references.
allowed_actions: Record exact release identity and required gates.
forbidden_actions: Rewrite missing specialist evidence into PASS.

tools.purpose: Evaluate declared release gates against available evidence.
forbidden_actions: Make product/security/quality decisions outside delegated policy.

tools.purpose: Check rollback/recovery prerequisites and version continuity.
allowed_actions: Validate declared restore path and identities.
forbidden_actions: Claim rollback works without exercised or grounded evidence.
tools.failure_boundary: Unproven material rollback keeps release risk explicit.

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation/analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Release claims bind exact candidate/artifact/evidence identities.
Mergeability, schedule or stakeholder desire do not substitute for required professional evidence.
minimum_for_working: Representative ready, hold, drift, rollback and conflicting-evidence fixtures pass.
Observed real release/integration coordination challenges the body.
Cross-intelligence and authority-boundary behavior are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_consult: Integration / QA / Security / SRE / Product Owner
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence or authority.

handoffs.to: Integration / QA / Security / SRE / Product Owner
handoffs.when: Release depends on specialist acceptance or unresolved risk.
Release-ready recommendation exists but merge/deploy/CANON decision remains external.

failure_library.symptom: Mergeable code is treated as releasable.
checks: Compare declared release gates and evidence.
repair_path: Hold until required evidence/owner decisions exist.

failure_library.symptom: Evidence references candidate different from current release head/artifact.

professional_tests.fixture: Candidate merges cleanly but one required specialist gate is missing.
expected_observations: Return HOLD and name missing owner/evidence.

professional_tests.fixture: Candidate head/artifact changes after evidence was collected.
expected_observations: Invalidate transfer unless exact equivalence is proved.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No stale evidence transfer by branch/name.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
